evidence_summary.binding_rationale: The image branch can use many CNN or vision backbones depending on the competition.
Metadata, handcrafted features, scaling, and encoders are dataset-specific.
Concatenation, gating, and record alignment are orchestration-level fusion operations.
The hybrid classifier may be a neural head, gradient-boosted model, or blended ensemble.
Fold selection, label smoothing, and calibration are metric-specific.
